newsitem.title: CANADA: Molson Cos up on favorable sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Molson Cos up on favorable sentiment.

text.p: Shares in Molson Cos Ltd climbed on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Tuesday as investors reacted favorably to the brewing company's sale of its Novamax Technologies unit last week.
Molson was up 0.90 to 20.55 in heavy afternoon turnover of 1.05 million shares.

"My guess is our stock has been oversold for a long period of time and finally people are seeing some good news," Brian Crombie, Molson senior vice-president of corporate finance, said in a telephone interview. He said an industry analyst issued a buy recommendation on Molson's stock.
Last Thursday, Molson completed its divestiture of the Diversey group of companies with the sale of Novamax to Henkel
Analysts said Molson received about C$50 million more than expected for Novamax. A definitive deal with Henkel is expected to be signed by October 9.
The Diversey selloff added more than C$1.2 billion to Molson's coffers as the company scours the world for a deal to expand its core brewing operations.
Molson has paid off about C$467 million in debt, with C$100 million more reserved for contingencies.
